thread:
alex: Hey team — we need a GCP quota increase and project approval for a Dedicated inference fleet. Creating project `redwood-dedicated-prod` and need GPU quotas in multiple regions (H100 in us-west1, L4 in europe-west4, small A100 reserve in us-central1). Can someone kick off the GCP request?

sam: @alex do you have project ID, billing account, and exact counts? Also any org-policy blocks for GPUs in EU?

alex: Project ID: `redwood-dedicated-prod`
Billing acct: `BAC-0A1B2C3D4E`
Quotas needed (initial): H100 (us-west1) = 48, L4 (europe-west4) = 32, A100 (us-central1) = 16
Reason: production inference capacity for Redwood Dedicated (infer replicas + warm caches), low-latency customer traffic. We plan to spin up 6 nodes in us-west1 (8 H100 each) and 4 nodes in europe-west4 (8 L4 each).

mira: tagging security/ops: any Sensitive Data? Will this project need VPC-SC or restricted-service-perimeter?

alex: No customer PII stored on these nodes; inference only. VPC will be peered to our private control plane via Shared VPC. Security flagged IAM service accounts required: `infra-inference-sa@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com` with `roles/compute.admin, roles/iam.serviceAccountUser, roles/serviceusage.serviceUsageConsumer`.

sam: Cool. Please run quota checks so the support request has current numbers. Use:```gcloud compute regions describe us-west1 --project=redwood-dedicated-prod && gcloud compute project-info describe --project=redwood-dedicated-prod```

alex: ran checks, current GPU quotas are 0 for H100 in us-west1 and 0 for L4 in europe-west4, default A100 quota small. Added the outputs to the ticket.

cloud-req-bot: Automated: Please fill the GCP GPU quota increase form: https://console.cloud.google.com/iam-admin/quotas?project=redwood-dedicated-prod — include justification, expected start date, and whether you need a reservation.

alex: Filled it out, justification pasted: "Production inference for Redwood Dedicated; required for customer SLAs and warm cache to meet 50ms 95p. Initial ramp 48 H100 (us-west1) + 32 L4 (europe-west4); estimate 3-month steady usage, likely to request committed use discounts after stabilization." Linked our perf benchmarks (internal doc): https://redwood.internal/perf/dedicated-warm-cache

mira: FYI org policies — europe-west4 GPU allocation requires Security review for cross-border compute. Pinged @ops-approvals and security.

ops-approvals: Approved to proceed with quota request and project creation pending finance confirmation of billing account. Please attach cost estimate and tag spend center `dedicated-prod`.

sam: Cost snapshot for planning: conservative estimate H100 ~ $25/hr (on-demand) each => 48 * $25 = $1200/hr (us-west1) ; L4 ~ $4/hr each => 32 * $4 = $128/hr (europe-west4). We'll pursue committed discounts / reservations once traffic stabilizes. Add note: GPUs increase networking egress costs; set budget alerts.

alex: Added budget alert: `dedicated-prod-gpu` -> notify infra + finance at 80%/90%. Also request increased networking quotas: 10Gbps interconnect per-project and raise firewall connection tracking to 500k.

cloud-req-bot: Required attachments missing: billing confirmation screenshot, service account list, and approved ops-approvals message.

alex: Uploaded attachments. Submitted support request to GCP: Ticket #987654321. Message included justification and perf graphs.

gcp-support-bot: GCP Support: Ticket #987654321 received. Initial triage within 48 business hours. Please ensure project and org admins can approve quota via the console link sent.

mira: Noted. I added `infra-admins` group to project with `roles/owner` temporarily so GCP can validate. Will remove after quota done.

ops-approvals: Quick check — make sure Service Perimeter doesn't block quota change. If it does, we can route via parent org request.

alex: Thanks. I'll monitor. If GCP asks for region capacity justification I can include our latency SLA and customer regions.

gcp-support-bot: Update: GCP approved partial increase — H100 in us-west1 bumped to 24 (instead of 48) pending capacity constraints, L4 in europe-west4 approved to 32. You may request further increase once H100 capacity availability confirmed. Support link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/tickets/987654321

sam: Good progress. Can we start with 24 H100 nodes? We should scale jobs to distribute across H100+L4 and validate warm cache.

alex: Yes starting with 24 H100 is fine. I'll update infra deploys and reserve warm VMs. Will re-open quota request for the remaining 24 H100 in 72h if capacity frees up. :thumbsup:

ops-approvals: Approved to proceed with incremental rollout. Keep this thread updated and close when all quotas are at target.

alex: Closing loop — deployed initial fleet with 24 H100 (us-west1) and 32 L4 (europe-west4). Leaving ticket open for follow-up on the remaining H100s. Thanks everyone.
